connector.name: Salonrunner MCP
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted MCP to find, book, and cancel salon appointments via SalonRunner.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package salonrunner-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the topness-msft account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SALONRUNNER_SALON_ID
env.description: Your salon's numeric id (from your booking URL)

env.name: SALONRUNNER_USERNAME
env.description: Your SalonRunner client login (same as the booking site)
